title: 4-Hydroxybenzoato-rare earth(III) complexes – syntheses, a structural goldmine from coordination diversity and improved corrosion inhibition behaviour

synthesis.procedure: Sodium 4-hydroxybenzoate prepared in situ was reacted with a hydrated lanthanum nitrate in water at a 3:1 ligand-to-metal molar ratio, typically using 0.5–1.5 mmol of metal salt. The room-temperature reaction was conducted for 2 h; crystals formed by slow evaporation.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Precipitate collected; single crystals obtained by slow evaporation.

synthesis.procedure: Sodium 4-hydroxybenzoate prepared in situ was reacted with hydrated cerium chloride in water at a 3:1 ligand-to-metal molar ratio, typically using 0.5–1.5 mmol of metal salt. The reaction was conducted at room temperature for 2 h; twinned single crystals formed above the solvent line.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Twinned single crystals isolated above the solvent line.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The twinned single crystals reveal a carboxylate-bridged two-dimensional sheet distinct from the La single-crystal structure in lattice water, arene orientations and water–Ce–water angle. The bulk Ce powder instead matches the La-structure powder pattern; the twinning limited structural determination.

synthesis.procedure: Sodium 4-hydroxybenzoate prepared in situ was reacted with hydrated praseodymium nitrate in water at a 3:1 ligand-to-metal molar ratio, typically using 0.5–1.5 mmol of metal salt. The room-temperature reaction lasted 4 h; green crystals formed on slow evaporation of the filtrate.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow evaporation of the filtrate yielded green crystals.

synthesis.procedure: Sodium 4-hydroxybenzoate prepared in situ was reacted with hydrated europium chloride in water at a 3:1 ligand-to-metal molar ratio, typically using 0.5–1.5 mmol of metal salt, at room temperature for 2 h. Seeding a solution of the bulk product with a crystal of the analogous Y type b dimer enabled isolation of the Eu type b crystals.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Aqueous salt metathesis and crystal seeding
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Seeded with a Y type b dimer single crystal.

synthesis.procedure: YCl3·6H2O (0.51 mmol), sodium 4-hydroxybenzoate (1.50 mmol) and distilled water (10 mL) were sealed in a Teflon-lined autoclave, heated at 20 °C min−1 to 120 °C for 2 h, then cooled at 0.1 °C min−1. The resulting colourless crystals included this polymer and the Y type b dimer.

synthesis.procedure: Sodium 4-hydroxybenzoate prepared in situ was reacted with hydrated terbium nitrate in water at a 3:1 ligand-to-metal molar ratio, typically using 0.5–1.5 mmol of metal salt.
